messages:
mike: Quick question — can we make the Hosted/Dedicated/Private adapter surface smaller? I'm seeing 4 different auth paths and it complicates the control plane.
alexa: +1, can you outline which bits are duplicative? I skimmed last RFC but not sure on auth handoff.
mike: The duplications: token exchange, tenant mapping, KMS wrapping, and audit propagation. Dedicated & Private each reimplement token exchange logic.
yang: Suggestion: introduce a small AuthShim interface that normalizes {principal, tenant_id, creds_ref} and returns a canonical session. Then adapters implement only mapping.
priya: Love the idea. Concern: latency — adding shim may add a network hop for hosted. Can we inline for Hosted?
mike: We could allow in-process AuthShim for Hosted and gRPC for Dedicated/Private. Add capability negotiation in handshake.
sam: How would rollout look? we need canary strategy. If handshake fails, fallback to current behavior.
mike: Plan: 1) spec AuthShim proto, 2) implement in-process + gRPC server, 3) add feature flag and canary on 10% traffic, 4) metrics for handshake latency & failures.
yang: proto snippet:
```proto
message AuthRequest { string raw_token = 1; string tenant_hint = 2; }
message AuthResponse { string principal = 1; string tenant_id = 2; map<string,string> meta = 3; }
service AuthShim { rpc Normalize(AuthRequest) returns (AuthResponse); }
```
priya: Also include a `capabilities` field so adapters can say `supports_audit_propagation=true` — avoid boolean explosion later.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started on infra/dedicated-adapter v2.1 -> 10% :rocket:
alexa: Ops - please add tracing headers so we can correlate
mike: will add `X-AuthShim-Trace` header and a debug flag
sam: One more edge: older private deployments may not support gRPC over TLS with our certs. Need a fallback plaintext sock with mTLS option.
yang: Agreed. Add capability `conn_modes: ["tls","mtls","plaintext"]`
priya: TL;DR: auth normalization shim + capability negotiation + inproc opt path. I'll draft followup RFC and owner.
mike: thanks — assign to @priya for RFC, @yang for proto, @alexa for rollout plan
alexa: I'll coordinate canary metrics/dashboard
mike: awesome. ping if blockers.
